For the rock salt (NaCl) structure, there are **4 formula units per unit cell** (Z = 4).

The density relation is:

$$\rho = \frac{Z \cdot M}{a^{3} N_{A}}$$

with $M_{\text{FeO}} = 55.85 + 16.00 = 71.85\ \mathrm{g/mol}$.

Solving for $a$:

$$a = \left(\frac{Z M}{\rho N_{A}}\right)^{1/3} = \left(\frac{4 \times 71.85}{5.70 \times 6.022\times10^{23}}\right)^{1/3}$$

$$a \approx 4.375\times10^{-8}\ \mathrm{cm} = 0.4375\ \mathrm{nm}$$

$$\boxed{0.4375}$$
